unit_period_analysis: Unit-period = 1 month (most frequent common period). w = 12 unit-periods per year. From advance 1-10-78 to first payment 2-10-78 = exactly 1 full unit-period, so t = 1 and f = 0 (no fractional unit-period).
computation: Special form of general equation for single-advance, otherwise regular: A = P * [1/(1+i)^t * (1 - (1+i)^(-n))/(i) ] with f=0. Substituting: 5000 = 230 * sum_{k=1 to 24} 1/(1+i)^k. Solve iteratively for unit-period rate i. Iteration yields i ≈ 0.0080714. Then APR = w * i = 12 * 0.0080714 = 0.0969.
weakest_point: Exact intermediate iteration values for i (Appendix J states result from 10-digit calculator iteration).

case_name: Monthly payments with long (odd) first period
unit_period_analysis: Unit-period = 1 month; w = 12. Measure full unit-periods backward from later date: from 3-1-78 to 4-1-78 = 1 full unit-period (t = 1). Remaining fraction measured forward from earlier date: 2-10-78 to 3-1-78 = 19 days; f = 19/30.
computation: Equation: 6000 = 200 * [1/(1+i)^{t+f} * (1 - (1+i)^(-n))/i ]. With t=1, f=19/30: 6000 = 200 * sum of discounted payments starting after fractional period. Iterate for i. Resulting i ≈ 0.00985. APR = w * i = 12 * i = 0.1182.
weakest_point: Precise value of i before multiplication by w (stated APR is the published outcome).

case_name: Single-advance single-payment (term < 1 year, measured in days)
unit_period_analysis: Single-advance, single-payment rule: unit-period = term of transaction (but ≤ 1 year). Term = 255 days, so unit-period = 255 days; w = 365/255. t = 1, f = 0 (entire term is one unit-period).
weakest_point: Exact day count 255 is as published; minor calendar variation possible but matches Appendix J.

case_name: Monthly payments with irregular first payment (regular first period)
unit_period_analysis: Unit-period = 1 month; w = 12. From 1-10-78 to 2-10-78 = exactly 1 unit-period → t = 1, f = 0. First payment is irregular (odd); remaining 23 payments regular.
weakest_point: Exact intermediate i from iteration (APR is the published rounded result).

case_name: Monthly payments with irregular final payment (regular first period)
unit_period_analysis: Unit-period = 1 month; w = 12. From advance to first payment = 1 full unit-period → t = 1, f = 0. Payments 1–23 regular; final (24th) payment irregular.
weakest_point: Precise i value prior to rounding to two decimal places for APR.
